notes: Amazon: only 'AMAZON' is printed in the strip; the 'AVE.' of the same street is printed farther east (about x 6150, y 2500), so read as Amazon Avenue, running from its dead end at x 4648 past the foot of Egbert Avenue to Clifton Avenue. Lafayette Avenue: name printed west of the strip (about x 2000, y 4550) and east of Clifton; at Clifton the east part sits about 18 px north of the west part. Greendale and Woolper: suffix not printed near Clifton, 'Avenue' assumed. Rural Lane (20 ft) and Dell Eva Lane (30 ft) are narrow named lanes east off Clifton. Belsaw Place is a 25 ft private loop ('Lot A') entered from Clifton by a narrow arm at y 4926; a narrow strip marked 6" W. PIPE running north from its NE corner (x 5080, y 4330-4560) and then a single line to Clifton is a pipe line, not picked as a street. Thick lines inside streets are water pipes; centres are taken midway between lot lines. McAlpin Avenue ends at Clifton (plate cut away to the east); Middleton and Clifton have stubs continuing south off the plate.
